ov: القتل المبرر (الإنجليزية: Righteous Kill)، فيلم جريمة وإثارة أمريكي، من إنتاج 2008، سيناريو راسيل غويرتز، إخراج جون آفنيت، بطولة روبرت دي نيرو وآل باتشينو، في ثالث اجتماع سينمائي لهم بعد فيلم العراب الجزء الثاني وفيلم الأكشن حرارة (كلاهما ظهر في فلم العراب: الجزء الثاني لكن ليس في المشهد نفسه). الفلم يضم أيضا جون ليجويزامو، كارلا جوجينو، دوني والبيرغ، بريان دينيهي و50 سنت: كرتس جيمس جاكسون. صدر الفيلم في الولايات المتحدة في 12 سبتمبر 2008.
plotEn:
Police psychologists are reviewing video recordings in which Detective David Fisk, a.k.a. "Turk" discusses how much he admires his partner of almost 30 years, Detective Tom Cowan, a.k.a. "Rooster".
Forward to Fisk and Cowan investigating the murder of a pimp named Robert "Rambo" Brady. Less experienced detectives Karen Corelli, Simon Perez and Ted Riley are also on the case. When they find a poem on the body, the cops deduce it is the tenth victim of a serial killer called The Poetry Boy for his modus operandi of murdering criminals and leaving short poems with their bodies. 
Other victims of Poetry Boy then include acquitted rapist Jonathan Van Luytens, and a Catholic priest named Father Connell, a child molester whose victims we learn included Poetry Boy. 
Tension arises among the detectives when Cowan starts living with Perez's ex-girlfriend, Corelli.
Russian mobster Yevgeny Magulat then survives an assault by Poetry Boy, shoots at Perez's house and rapes Corelli.
Suspecting Cowan of being Poetry Boy due to his marksmanship skills and troubling psych evaluations, Perez and Riley arrange to secretly observe a meeting between Cowan and suspected drug dealer Marcus "Spider" Smith. Expecting Cowan to reveal his homicidal tendencies, he's instead proven innocent by having a firearm inconsistent with Poetry Boy's, and reciting a humiliating poem that is also inconsistent with the killer's style.
